description: Ouvrages hydrauliques prioritaires dans le SAGE Estuaire de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SYLOA. Les ouvrages hydrauliques peuvent avoir un impact fort sur la continuité écologique. Notion introduite en 2000 par la directive cadre sur l’eau, la continuité écologique d’un cours d’eau est définie comme la libre circulation des organismes vivants et leur accès aux zones indispensables à leur reproduction, leur croissance, leur alimentation ou leur abri, le bon ... Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are continuité écologique, ouvrages hydrauliques, cours d'eau, Aménagement hydraulique. The portal shows 94 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
